maddeler.e:
نتشاوظ (form VI)
# نَتَشَاوَظُ (natašāwaẓu) /na.ta.ʃaː.wa.ðˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَشَاوَظَ (tašāwaẓa)
# نَتَشَاوَظَ (natašāwaẓa) /na.ta.ʃaː.wa.ðˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَاوَظَ (tašāwaẓa)
# نَتَشَاوَظْ (natašāwaẓ) /na.ta.ʃaː.waðˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَاوَظَ (tašāwaẓa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
